title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on the Calculation Standard for Compensation for Infringement of Citizens' Personal Freedom in State Compensation Decisions Made in 2024
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on the Calculation Standard for Compensation for Infringement of Personal Freedom Involved in State Compensation Decisions Made in 2024

Fa [2024] No. 102

To the High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

According to the data published by the National Bureau of Statistics on May 17, 2024, the average annual wage of employed persons in urban non-private units nationwide in 2023 was RMB 120,698. Calculated in accordance with the formula for daily average wage provided by the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, the daily average wage is RMB 462.44. Pursuant to Article 33 of the State Compensation Law and the provisions of Article 21, Paragraph 2 of the "Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Certain Issues concerning the Application of Law in the Handling of Criminal Compensation Cases," when the people's courts at all levels make state compensation decisions from May 20, 2024, the compensation for infringement of personal freedom of citizens shall be calculated at RMB 462.44 per day.

You are hereby notified, and compliance is required.

May 20, 2024
